content.body: title = Basic Weapon Training 1.0.label = This is my weapon 1.1.alert.modal = As a rifleman, your primary weapon is the rifle. All rifles operate the same way. 1.1.alert.hilite = primary 1.1.alert1.modal = Rifles are the primary weapon for all armies. They are slow firing, but very accurate. 1.1.alert2 = You are standing near the training grounds infantry firing range. Move to the 50 meter firing position. A waypoint has been added to your minimap. 1.1.alert2.hilite = minimap 1.1.label = move to firing position 1.1.complete = Good job, now lets fire off some rounds. 1.2.alert = By default, your rifle is at rest. Try firing from the hip at the target down range with {fpfire}. 1.2.label = take your first shot 1.2.complete = As you can see, its difficult to hit anything shooting from the hip. 1.3.alert.modal = Bolt-action weapons like your rifle automatically recycle the next round if you weapon is not empty. You can prevent this by holding down {fpfire} after firing. This will let you see your round hit. Once you let up, you will automatically recycle the weapon's next round. 1.3.alert1.modal = When you run out of ammo, you will need to reload using the {fpreload}. When your weapon is empty, you will hear a click when you hit {fpfire}. You must manually reload. 1.3.alert2 = Fire off a few more rounds if you like with {fpfire} and reload your rifle with {fpreload} when you are ready. 1.3.hilite = primary-clips 1.3.label = fire and reload 1.3.complete = Good job, your rifle has ammo again and your clip count went down by one. You don't have to wait until your weapon is empty to reload it. 1.4.alert.modal = As you might guess, you should use the rifle's iron sights to aim down the barrel of the weapon. 1.4.alert1.modal = When you aim, you will take a breath to keep your weapon steady. The longer you hold the aim, the harder it will be to keep the weapon still. 1.4.alert2 = Try shooting at the targets down range by aiming {fpgunsight} and firing {fpfire}. Score 3 aimed hits to continue. 1.4.shot1 = 1 down, 2 to go! 1.4.shot2 = 2 hits, 1 more to go! 1.4.label = shoot the targets 1.4.complete = Excellent, using your gunsights in combat is very important.
content.brief: Learn how to use the weapons of the basic infantryman.
content.title: Basic Weaponry
